title: Beyond Denouncing Hate: Strategies for Countering Implied Biases and Stereotypes in Language

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting implied stereotypes about gender from social media posts and analyzing the frequency, distribution, and persuasiveness of six specific counter-speech strategies (e.g., alternate qualities, external factors, general denouncing) in human and LLM-generated responses.
Evaluating human and machine-generated counterspeech to challenge implied generic stereotypes about racial and ethnic groups, comparing strategy usage across persuasive and non-persuasive arguments.
Extracting implied stereotypes about sexual orientation from harmful posts and assessing human preferences for different stereotype-targeting strategies through a crowdsourced user study.
Labeling and categorizing counterspeech strategies used to challenge prejudiced generic statements about religious groups in Reddit discussions and hate speech datasets.

Comparing the usage of psychologically inspired counterspeech strategies (such as providing structural/external factors) against implied stereotypes targeting low-income or specific socioeconomic statuses.
Analyzing the persuasive strategies used in human and LLM counterspeech to challenge stereotypical implications about physical appearance and weight.
